QuestInfo.name: The Dragon Rider's Identity 1
QuestInfo.0: According to rumors, something has been appearing near Leafre and causing problems for the town. Go see #bChief Tatamo#k to find out more details.
QuestInfo.1: Go meet #bChief Tatamo#k in Leafre and found out about what's been happening in there.
QuestInfo.2: You met with #bChief Tatamo#k and received a request to investigate the strange case happening in the town.

0.0: Ahem... Can you hear me? #b#h0##k, my town is in dire need of help. Please listen to my plea. I beg you.

yes.0: Many strange things have been happening in Leafre. As the town chief, I have been trying to handle it, but I haven't been able to do much. We need a true warrior like you, #b#h0##k to help us!
yes.1: Please consider my plea, and then talk to me, #bTatamo#k, the chief of Leafre.

no.0: In that case, our town is doomed for sure...

1.0: Have you made your decision? I had no doubt, #b#h0##k, that you would help.

yes.0: My town has remained peaceful by maintaining good relations with the Dragon race. But recently, strange things have happened.
